reason: Free and local takes the money out of it, but my time is the real cost. I'm not going to spend a billable afternoon recording sessions and checking business rules an AI wrote about my client's app when my test suite already covers the parts I care about.
objection: It uses AI to decide what the app is supposed to do. If it gets one rule wrong, or buries me in diffs that don't matter, I've lost more time than I saved, and then I'm the one telling the client the migration is safe.
would_change_my_mind: Running it on one small client app during the migration and having it catch a real regression my tests missed, with no noise, in under an hour of setup.
